loterica-nova.description: Lottery betting intermediation platform. I worked on the new design, maintained the administrative features and built the ticket printing system validated by the lottery machine.

medguias.description: Digital and printed medical directory with over 10,000 registered doctors: specialist search, in person or via telemedicine, WhatsApp-integrated scheduling and a digital patient record with prescriptions and history. I worked on maintenance and new features, including fixing the scheduling with time zones.

lide-global.description: Digital platform of LIDE, the largest business leaders' organization in Latin America: CRM, admin panel and mobile app connecting thousands of leaders for networking, events and business. Backend, panel and app built from scratch, leading the mobile team.

blocos-dinamicos.description: E-commerce for dynamic SketchUp plugins, integrated with an exclusive Ruby plugin that lets users buy components from inside SketchUp. Developed end to end, from client alignment to production deploy.

busca-global.description: Web platform connecting those who search with those who offer: companies and professionals register their businesses and the public finds everything in one place. Built from scratch, from the data model to the interface, with an admin panel for managing listings.

sebrae.description: Sebrae's digital education hub for micro and small business owners: courses, learning journeys, mentoring and live classes with experts, with digital certificates. In 2025 it ran 18 courses across more than 1,800 classes. I worked on new features, admin panel fixes and the Cypress E2E test suite.

clipify.description: Viral distribution platform connecting content creators and clippers: the creator opens campaigns with prizes, clippers publish the cuts and the system tracks views and prize distribution. Web app built from scratch in React with MUI and a PHP/Laravel backend.

i3pics.description: Mobile app built from scratch in React Native and published to the stores. I took part in defining the modular architecture that became a reference for the team, focused on decoupling, testability and test coverage.

humu.description: Humu's internet banking, web and mobile: payment account, Pix, transfers, bank slip issuance and reconciliation, and financial management for businesses and consumers. I work on maintaining and evolving the interfaces, with a focus on security, data integrity and LGPD compliance.

lugpay.description: Rental management platform for owners and property managers: property registration, contract generation, billing and financial control, centralized contacts and requests, and a tax calculator, all in a single dashboard. Built from scratch for JMN.

adenpay.description: Internet banking and app for Aden Bank's digital account: real-time balance and statement, Pix, transfers and payments straight from the phone or the web, with no red tape. Web interface in React and iOS and Android app in React Native.

helpmeup.description: Home services marketplace connecting clients to vetted providers within a 5 km radius: residential and commercial cleaning, babysitting, pet and plant care, gardening and more. Booking, card payment and ratings right in the app, built from scratch in React Native.

porti.description: Financial ecosystem for doctors: the Portí Pay digital account, advance payment of shift earnings within 48 hours, and financial and accounting management for the medical company. Over 3,000 doctors and R$ 21 million transacted. Internet banking in React and app in React Native.

orbit.description: Virtual assets and financial solutions platform of a virtual asset service provider (SPSAV) under regulation by the Central Bank of Brazil: buying, selling and custody of crypto and stablecoins with a focus on security and liquidity for high-volume operations. Internet banking in React and app in React Native.

way.description: Subscription platform for dentists and dentistry students: clinical decision tree, anamnesis script, pharmacological manual, technical content, forum and calendar. iOS and Android app in React Native and web backoffice in React.
